context.body: The earlier report becomes a warning about how one group’s choice can discourage the whole people.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Moses challenges Reuben and Gad for discouraging Israel from crossing and retells the mission from Kadesh Barnea.
observations.label: Moses warns the next generation by recalling the spies: action

observations.body: He recalls the LORD’s anger, the excluded generation, Caleb and Joshua’s full following, and warns against renewing that failure.
observations.label: Moses warns the next generation by recalling the spies: response

observations.body: discourage · Kadesh Barnea · did not follow fully · Caleb · Joshua · increase fierce anger
observations.label: Words in Numbers 32:6–15

payload.posture: Read Numbers 32:6–15 as presumption and later retelling evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The warning applies the earlier event to a new proposal without claiming that the two situations are identical.
payload.title: Moses warns the next generation by recalling the spies
